title: DEM-o-gorgon: a QGIS plugin to flip a DEM into the upside down
description: QGIS plugin that inverts a digital elevation model (peaks become pits, valleys become ridges) and applies a ready-made dark retro-horror style with optional hillshade. Three inversion modes: around min + max, around sea level (0 m) or around a custom elevation. / Plugin de QGIS que invierte un modelo digital de elevaciones (los picos se vuelven fosas y los valles, crestas) y aplica un estilo oscuro de terror retro con sombreado opcional.
